name_zh: 赛力斯集团股份有限公司

key_facts.value_en: 1986 (predecessor, Chongqing Fenghuang Electric Spring Factory); listed entity traces to 2002 (Yu'an Group) and 2007 (Sokon Industrial)
key_facts.value_zh: 1986 年（前身重庆凤凰电器弹簧厂）；上市主体沿革为 2002 年渝安集团、2007 年小康工业

key_facts.value_en: Zhang Xinghai (identified as actual controller in the 2025 annual report; holds 50% of Chongqing Sokon Holdings)
key_facts.value_zh: 张兴海（2025 年年报认定为实际控制人；持有重庆小康控股 50% 股权）

key_facts.label_en: Net profit attributable to the parent (FY2025)

key_facts.label_zh: 新能源汽车销量（2025 年）

key_facts.value_en: 28,641 units (of which 7,778 new energy vehicles and 20,863 other vehicles)
key_facts.value_zh: 28,641 辆（其中新能源汽车 7,778 辆、其他车型 20,863 辆）

history.event_en: Zhang Xinghai founds the Chongqing Fenghuang Electric Spring Factory, the company's predecessor, starting with automotive seat springs and shock absorbers.
history.event_zh: 张兴海创办重庆凤凰电器弹簧厂（公司前身），从汽车座椅弹簧、减震器起家。

history.event_en: Chongqing Yu'an Group is established, consolidating the founder's motorcycle, shock absorber and auto-parts businesses.
history.event_zh: 成立重庆渝安集团，整合摩托车、减震器、汽车等业务。

history.event_en: Yu'an forms Dongfeng Yu'an Vehicle Co. with Dongfeng Motor and Dongfeng Industrial, launching the Dongfeng Sokon (DFSK) micro-vehicle brand.
history.event_zh: 与东风汽车、东风实业合资组建东风渝安车辆有限公司，推出东风小康品牌微车。

history.event_en: Yu'an Group is renamed Chongqing Sokon Industrial Group.
history.event_zh: 渝安集团更名为重庆小康工业集团。

history.event_en: Sokon Industrial lists on the Shanghai Stock Exchange as 601127 and pivots to new energy vehicles, investing to build the Jinkang NEV unit.
history.event_zh: 小康股份在上交所上市（601127），并转型新能源汽车，投入建设金康新能源。

history.event_en: The Liangjiang smart factory is commissioned and the first SERES model, the SF5, is launched.
history.event_zh: 赛力斯两江智慧工厂投产，发布首款新能源汽车 SF5。

history.event_en: Seres and Huawei reach deep cooperation; the Seres-Huawei Smart Selection SF5 goes on sale.
history.event_zh: 与华为达成深度合作，赛力斯华为智选 SF5 上市。

history.event_en: Seres and Huawei launch the premium AITO (问界) brand and its first model, the M5.
history.event_zh: 与华为联合发布高端品牌问界（AITO）及首款车型 M5。

history.event_en: Sokon Industrial is renamed Seres Group Co., Ltd.; the A-share short name changes from Sokon Industrial to Seres.
history.event_zh: 小康股份更名为赛力斯集团股份有限公司，证券简称由「小康股份」变更为「赛力斯」。

history.event_en: Seres launches the mass-market Landian (蓝电) brand and its first model, the Landian E5, a plug-in hybrid mid-size SUV priced from RMB139,900.
history.event_zh: 发布蓝电品牌及首款车型蓝电 E5，定位电混中型 SUV，13.99 万元起。

history.event_en: AITO launches the full-size flagship SUV M9.
history.event_zh: 问界发布全景智慧旗舰 SUV 问界 M9。

history.event_en: The Seres Super Factory in Chongqing Liangjiang is commissioned and first M9 deliveries begin.
history.event_zh: 赛力斯超级工厂在重庆两江新区建成投用，问界 M9 开启首批交付。

history.event_en: Seres Auto agrees to buy 919 AITO/问界 trademarks and 44 design patents from Huawei for RMB2.5 billion (excluding tax).
history.event_zh: 赛力斯汽车公告拟以 25 亿元（不含税）收购华为持有的 919 项问界等系列商标及 44 项外观设计专利。

history.event_en: Seres Auto signs to buy a 10% stake in Huawei's Shenzhen Yinwang Intelligent Technology for RMB11.5 billion; the transfer is registered on 31 March 2025 (Huawei 80%, Avatr 10%, Seres Auto 10%) and the consideration fully paid by September 2025.
history.event_zh: 赛力斯汽车签约以 115 亿元收购华为旗下深圳引望智能技术 10% 股权；2025 年 3 月 31 日完成过户（华为 80%、阿维塔 10%、赛力斯汽车 10%），对价于 2025 年 9 月付清。

history.event_en: Seres lists on the HKEX Main Board as 9927, becoming China's first A+H dual-listed premium NEV automaker.
history.event_zh: 赛力斯在港交所主板挂牌（9927.HK），成为首家「A+H」两地上市的豪华新能源车企。

history.event_en: The company reports that cumulative AITO deliveries have passed one million vehicles.
history.event_zh: 公司披露问界全系累计交付突破 100 万辆。

history.event_en: The 2025 annual general meeting elects the sixth board of directors; the subsequent first board meeting elects Zhang Xinghai chairman and appoints Yin Xianzhi president of the company.
history.event_zh: 2025 年年度股东会选举产生第六届董事会；随后召开的董事会会议选举张兴海为董事长、聘任尹先知为公司总裁。

history.event_en: Saidou Technology (formerly Chongqing Landian Technology) completes a capital increase of about RMB6.671 billion by third-party investors and an employee shareholding platform; Seres's stake is diluted to about 32.96%, it loses control, and the unit is deconsolidated.
history.event_zh: 赛豆科技（原重庆蓝电科技）引入第三方投资者及员工持股平台增资约 66.71 亿元完成交割，赛力斯持股稀释至约 32.96% 并丧失控制权，公司不再纳入合并报表。

history.event_en: HIMA and Seres announce a new AITO cooperation model: product definition, design, marketing, retail and service are led by Seres, with Huawei Terminal providing technology empowerment; AITO stays within HIMA.
history.event_zh: 鸿蒙智行与赛力斯宣布问界合作模式调整：产品定义、设计、品牌营销、渠道零售、服务体系由赛力斯主导，华为终端参与技术赋能，问界仍属鸿蒙智行体系。

history.event_en: Controlling shareholder Chongqing Sokon Holdings increases its holding to 23.23%, with persons acting in concert totalling 27.03%.
history.event_zh: 控股股东重庆小康控股持股比例升至 23.23%，与一致行动人合计 27.03%。

brands.role_en: Premium smart NEV brand co-developed with Huawei, the group's core brand.
brands.role_zh: 与华为联合打造的高端智能新能源汽车品牌，公司核心支柱品牌。
brands.price_band: RMB229,800–649,800 by starting price across the line-up: M5 from RMB229,800, M6 from RMB229,800, M7 from RMB279,800, M8 from RMB359,800, M9 from RMB479,800, M9 Ultimate from RMB649,800 (HIMA official guide prices, 2026)
brands.owner_note_en: Created with Huawei in December 2021 under the Smart Selection (later HIMA) model; it is not an equity joint venture. Seres Auto bought the AITO/问界 trademarks from Huawei in July 2024 for RMB2.5 billion, so the brand is owned by Seres. The line-up spans five SUVs (M5, M6, M7, M8, M9) in extended-range (EREV) and pure-electric variants; the M9 flagship has a CLTC range of 1,405 km and the M9 Ultimate long-wheelbase edition is among China's largest production NEVs. In 2025 AITO delivered more than 420,000 vehicles (M9 over 110,000, M8 over 150,000, new M7 over 110,000); as of 26 March 2026 cumulative deliveries had passed one million, and the company reported more than 1.2 million cumulative deliveries on 22 October 2026. The M6 opened pre-orders on 23 March 2026 with over 60,000 orders. From 15 September 2026, product definition, marketing, retail and service are led by Seres, with Huawei providing technology empowerment.
brands.owner_note_zh: 2021 年 12 月与华为在智选车（后升级为鸿蒙智行）模式下共创，并非股权合资公司。2024 年 7 月赛力斯汽车以 25 亿元收购华为持有的问界/AITO 商标，品牌归赛力斯所有。产品矩阵覆盖 M5、M6、M7、M8、M9 五款 SUV，提供增程与纯电两种动力；旗舰 M9 的 CLTC 综合续航达 1,405 公里，M9 Ultimate 领世加长版为中国量产尺寸最大的新能源 SUV 之一。2025 年问界交付超 42 万辆（M9 超 11 万辆、M8 超 15 万辆、全新 M7 超 11 万辆），截至 2026 年 3 月 26 日累计交付突破 100 万辆，截至 10 月 22 日公司披露累计交付超过 120 万辆。M6 于 2026 年 3 月 23 日开启小订、订单突破 6 万。2026 年 9 月 15 日起，产品定义、营销、零售与服务改由赛力斯主导，华为提供技术赋能。

brands.role_en: Mass-market (RMB100,000–150,000) NEV brand launched in March 2023; divested in 2026.
brands.role_zh: 2023 年 3 月推出的大众化（10 万–15 万元）新能源品牌，2026 年剥离。
brands.price_band: RMB100,000–150,000; Landian E5 launched from RMB139,900 (March 2023)
brands.owner_note_en: First model the E5 launched 30 March 2023, using a FinDreams (BYD-affiliated) hybrid powertrain and a Huawei HiCar head unit. In late May 2026 Chongqing Landian Technology was renamed Saidou Technology, and on 9 June 2026 it launched the AI-defined AIVA brand. That year Saidou Technology raised about RMB6.671 billion from third-party investors and an employee shareholding platform, diluting Seres's remaining stake; after the deal completed in July 2026, Seres's holding fell to about 32.96% and it lost control, so the unit was deconsolidated.
brands.owner_note_zh: 首款车型蓝电 E5 于 2023 年 3 月 30 日上市，搭载弗迪动力混动系统与华为 HiCar 车机。2026 年 5 月底，重庆蓝电科技更名为赛豆科技，6 月 9 日发布主打「AI 定义汽车」的新品牌 AIVA。同年，赛豆科技引入第三方投资者及员工持股平台增资约 66.71 亿元，赛力斯剩余股权被稀释；2026 年 7 月增资交割完成后持股降至约 32.96% 并丧失控制权，不再纳入合并报表。

brands.role_en: Legacy commercial-vehicle and SUV business from the 2003 joint venture with Dongfeng; still produces fuel and NEV models and exports.
brands.role_zh: 2003 年与东风合资形成的传统商用车与 SUV 业务，仍生产燃油车与新能源车型并出口海外。
brands.owner_note_en: Formed in June 2003 as Dongfeng Yu'an Vehicle Co. (later Dongfeng Sokon) with Dongfeng Motor and Dongfeng Industrial. Dongfeng Motor Group remained Seres's second-largest shareholder with 18.79% of shares as of 2025-12-31. DFSK/Fengon models account for much of the group's traditional exports, which span Asia, Africa, Latin America and parts of Europe.
brands.owner_note_zh: 2003 年 6 月与东风汽车、东风实业合资组建东风渝安车辆有限公司（后为东风小康）。截至 2025 年末，东风汽车集团仍为赛力斯第二大股东，持股 18.79%。东风小康/风光车型构成集团传统出口的主体，覆盖亚洲、非洲、拉美及部分欧洲市场。

brands.role_en: The group's own NEV brand for overseas markets (SERES 5 / SERES 7). AITO also has overseas channel cooperation: in February 2026 it signed an agreement with Performance Plus Motors, an ADM subsidiary in the UAE. The agreement does not establish an official launch or actual deliveries.
brands.role_zh: 公司面向海外市场的自有新能源品牌（SERES 5 / SERES 7）；问界亦已开展海外渠道合作，2026 年 2 月与阿联酋 ADM 旗下 Performance Plus Motors 签署合作协议。该协议不等同于正式上市或实际交付。
brands.owner_note_en: SERES traces to SF Motors established in Silicon Valley in 2016; the first model SF5 launched in China in 2019. Since 2022–2023 the SERES 5 has been sold in European markets such as Norway, Germany, Denmark, Italy and the Netherlands, plus the Middle East and Latin America. AITO models were shown at the 2026 Paris Motor Show, where Seres announced a plan to enter the European market in autumn 2027.
brands.owner_note_zh: 赛力斯品牌源于 2016 年在美国硅谷成立的 SF Motors，首款车型 SF5 于 2019 年在中国发布。2022–2023 年起，SERES 5 在挪威、德国、丹麦、意大利、荷兰等欧洲市场及中东、拉美销售。问界车型亮相 2026 巴黎车展，赛力斯官宣计划 2027 年秋季进入欧洲市场。

financials.note_en: Fiscal year ends 31 December; figures are under PRC GAAP in RMB millions. 'net_profit' is net profit attributable to shareholders of the parent (归属于母公司股东的净利润, i.e. the listed company's equity holders), not the figure attributable to ordinary shareholders after preferred dividends. Revenue and net profit are taken from the audited annual reports: the 2024 annual report covers FY2022–FY2024 and the 2025 annual report covers FY2025; FY2022 R&D investment is cross-checked against the 2023 annual report. Gross margin is consolidated (29.14% in 2025), calculated as (revenue minus cost of sales) / revenue. Page 131 of the 2024 annual report explains that Accounting Standards for Business Enterprises Interpretation No. 18 reclassified RMB188,967,728.86 of FY2023 assurance-type warranty expenses from selling expenses to cost of sales. This reduced the calculated FY2023 margin from about 10.39% to 9.86%; the table uses the restated value. A similarly restated FY2022 cost of sales was not obtained, so FY2022 gross margin is null; the table does not mix the historical and restated bases. 'rnd' is total R&D investment (研发投入, including capitalised development expenditure) as disclosed by the company: FY2022 RMB3,105.9 million, FY2023 RMB4,438 million, FY2024 RMB7,053 million, FY2025 RMB12,511.9 million (annual-report value RMB12,511,927,167.32). The company was renamed from Sokon Industrial (小康股份) to Seres Group (赛力斯) in 2022; figures were not restated for the name change.
financials.note_zh: 财年截至 12 月 31 日；数据按中国会计准则（PRC GAAP）编制，单位为人民币百万元。「net_profit」为归属于母公司股东（上市公司股东）的净利润（归母口径），而非扣除优先股股息后的「归属于普通股股东」口径。营收与净利润取自经审计年报：2024 年年报覆盖 2022–2024 财年，2025 年年报覆盖 2025 财年；2022 年研发投入的比较数据另引 2023 年年报核对。毛利率按（营业收入−营业成本）÷营业收入计算，为集团综合口径（2025 年为 29.14%）。2024 年年报第 131 页披露，执行《企业会计准则解释第 18 号》时，将 2023 年保证类质量保证费用 188,967,728.86 元从销售费用转入营业成本；据此计算的 2023 年毛利率由原约 10.39% 调整为约 9.86%，本表采用调整后值。未取得同口径调整后的 2022 年营业成本，因此该年毛利率置为 null，不将历史口径与调整后口径混列。「rnd」为公司披露的研发投入（含资本化开发支出）：2022 年 31.06 亿元、2023 年 44.38 亿元、2024 年 70.53 亿元、2025 年 125.12 亿元（年报原值 12,511,927,167.32 元）。公司 2022 年由小康股份更名赛力斯，数字未因更名重述。

overview.en:
Seres Group Co., Ltd. is a Chongqing-headquartered automaker that makes premium new energy vehicles and owns the AITO (问界) brand built with Huawei. The company traces its roots to a 1986 spring factory and is now dual-listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange (601127) and the Hong Kong Stock Exchange (9927).[s6][s17] Its revenue comes overwhelmingly from new energy vehicle sales: in 2025 new energy vehicles contributed RMB155,611 million (about 94% of revenue), on total revenue of RMB165,054 million and attributable net profit of RMB5,957 million.[s1]

AITO is a brand within HIMA. The company reported that AITO delivered more than 420,000 vehicles in 2025 and was the best-selling Chinese premium brand in China's domestic market that year.[s5] The group sold 472,269 new energy vehicles in 2025.[s1] Under the Smart Selection model Seres handles vehicle manufacturing while Huawei contributes the HarmonySpace cockpit, the Qiankun ADS intelligent-driving stack and channel support; from 15 September 2026, product definition, marketing, retail and service are led by Seres, with Huawei providing technology.[s21]

The group also runs a legacy Dongfeng Sokon (DFSK)/Fengon commercial-vehicle and export business, and divested its mass-market Landian brand in 2026.[s6] After four consecutive loss-making years from 2020 to 2023, Seres returned to profit in 2024 and 2025, but swung back to an attributable net loss of RMB1,717 million in the first half of 2026, while January–September 2026 new energy vehicle sales fell 15.8% year on year.[s4][s11]
overview.zh:
赛力斯集团股份有限公司是一家总部位于重庆的高端新能源汽车制造商，也是与华为联合打造的 AITO（问界）品牌的所有者与制造商。公司前身可追溯至 1986 年的一家弹簧厂，现于上海证券交易所（601127）与香港联合交易所（9927）两地上市。[s6][s17] 公司收入几乎全部来自新能源汽车销售：2025 年新能源汽车收入 1,556.11 亿元（约占营收 94%），全年实现营收 1,650.54 亿元、归母净利润 59.57 亿元。[s1]

问界为鸿蒙智行体系内的品牌。公司披露，2025 年问界交付超 42 万辆，为当年国内市场销量最高的中国豪华品牌。[s5] 集团 2025 年新能源汽车销量为 472,269 辆。[s1] 在智选车（鸿蒙智行）模式下，赛力斯负责整车制造，华为提供鸿蒙座舱、乾崑智驾 ADS 等技术赋能与渠道支持；自 2026 年 9 月 15 日起，产品定义、营销、零售与服务改由赛力斯主导，华为提供技术赋能。[s21]

集团还经营东风小康（DFSK）/风光这一传统商用车与出口业务，并于 2026 年剥离了大众化品牌蓝电。[s6] 公司在 2020–2023 连续四年亏损后，于 2024 年扭亏、2025 年续盈，但 2026 年上半年归母净亏损 17.17 亿元，1–9 月新能源汽车销量同比下滑 15.8%。[s4][s11]

current.en:
Business structure

Seres's business is concentrated in new energy vehicles. In 2025 new energy vehicle revenue was RMB155,611 million (94.3% of revenue) and legacy fuel-vehicle revenue was RMB1,903 million (1.2%), the remainder being parts and other income; this NEV share is not the same as an AITO-brand revenue share, which the company does not disclose separately.[s1] Operating cash flow reached RMB28,914 million in 2025, up 28.4% year on year; net assets attributable to the parent rose to RMB40,918 million, the asset-liability ratio fell to 70.91%, and cash reached RMB87,287 million (60.66% of total assets) at year-end.[s1] Shareholders approved the FY2025 final dividend of RMB0.80 per share (tax inclusive) on 22 April 2026; A-share cash dividends were paid on 3 June. The implementation notice lists a final dividend total of about RMB1,392 million.[s12] The annual report's approximately RMB1,900 million full-year total (31.90% of attributable net profit) includes interim dividends and differs from the final dividend.[s1] The group also holds a 10% stake in Shenzhen Yinwang Intelligent Technology, Huawei's smart-car unit, acquired for RMB11.5 billion (registered 31 March 2025, fully paid by September 2025).[s19]

Products and technology

The AITO line-up spans five SUVs — M5, M6, M7, M8 and M9 — with starting prices from RMB229,800 to RMB479,800, plus the M9 Ultimate from RMB649,800, in extended-range (EREV) and pure-electric variants.[s16] The M9 flagship has a CLTC range of 1,405 km.[s16] The M6, positioned between the M5 and M7, opened pre-orders on 23 March 2026 with more than 60,000 orders within weeks.[s5] Seres's in-house technology centres on the Cube (魔方) platform, its super range-extender system and the Super Factory manufacturing system; the company says its range-extender business held more than 37.5% of the segment market in 2025.[s15]

R&D and intelligence

R&D investment was RMB12,511.9 million in 2025 (up 77.4%), with 9,019 R&D staff, 41.1% of the workforce.[s1] AITO users added 3.8 billion km of assisted-driving mileage in 2025.[s5] By September 2026 AITO had passed one million assisted-driving active users and 10 billion km of cumulative assisted-driving mileage.[s15] The company reports a maximum thermal efficiency of 44.8% and generation exceeding 3.65 kWh per litre for its super range-extender.[s15] It received MSCI ESG's top grade, AAA, in October 2025.[s5]

Manufacturing

The company's inquiry response gives the plant allocation as of 30 September 2024: Liangjiang produced the M5 series (designed capacity 50,000 units/year), Fenghuang the M7 series (100,000/year), and the Super Factory the M9 series (150,000/year). Other vehicle plants produced Fengon, Landian and Dongfeng Sokon models, among others (300,000/year). This is a historical allocation and does not establish model assignments or capacity at the research cutoff.[s10] A subsequent company investor-relations record states that the Super Factory achieved shared-line production of the AITO M8 and M9 in H1 2025.[s27] The Super Factory was previously leased; in 2025 the group completed a share-issue acquisition of 100% of the owner, Longsheng New Energy, for RMB8,164 million, bringing the plant onto its own balance sheet.[s1]

Domestic market position

AITO is the group's principal brand. In 2025 AITO delivered more than 420,000 vehicles, including more than 110,000 M9s (retaining the crown in the RMB500,000-plus segment), more than 150,000 M8s (first in the RMB400,000 segment) and more than 110,000 new M7s.[s23] Group-wide, total vehicle sales were 516,860 in 2025 (new energy vehicles 472,269), up from 497,008 in 2024 (new energy vehicles 426,885).[s1][s3] The group's H1 2026 gross margin was 23.30%; Q2 inventory days were 7.5. At 30 June, cash reserves exceeded RMB73,150 million (57.0% of assets; including monetary funds, financial assets held for trading and other items).[s4]

Overseas business

The group's overseas business centres on Dongfeng Sokon/Fengon traditional exports and its own SERES NEV brand. In 2025 overseas sales were 28,641 units (7,778 new energy vehicles and 20,863 others), with overseas revenue of RMB2,379 million.[s1] The SERES 5 has been sold in Europe, the Middle East and Latin America.[s6] An AITO release dated 6 February 2026 disclosed a UAE channel agreement with Performance Plus Motors, an ADM subsidiary responsible for local sales, delivery and after-sales service; the agreement itself does not establish an official launch or completed customer deliveries.[s26] In October 2026 AITO appeared at the Paris Motor Show, where Seres announced a plan to enter the European market in autumn 2027.[s14]
current.zh:
业务结构

赛力斯业务集中于新能源汽车。2025 年新能源汽车收入 1,556.11 亿元（占营收 94.3%），传统燃油车收入 19.03 亿元（占 1.2%），其余为零部件及其他收入；需说明该口径不等同于问界品牌收入占比，公司未单独披露问界品牌收入。[s1] 2025 年经营活动现金流量净额 289.14 亿元，同比增长 28.4%；年末归母净资产增至 409.18 亿元，资产负债率降至 70.91%，货币资金 872.87 亿元（占总资产 60.66%）。[s1] 2025 年末期分红每股 0.80 元（含税）已于 2026 年 4 月 22 日获股东会通过，A 股现金红利于 6 月 3 日发放；实施公告列示末期分红总额约 13.92 亿元。[s12] 年报列示的全年现金分红约 19.00 亿元（占归母净利润 31.90%）包含中期分红，须与末期分红区分。[s1] 集团另持有华为智能汽车业务主体深圳引望智能技术 10% 股权（对价 115 亿元，2025 年 3 月 31 日过户、9 月付清）。[s19]

产品与技术

问界产品线覆盖 M5、M6、M7、M8、M9 五款 SUV，起售价自 22.98 万至 47.98 万元，另有 M9 Ultimate 领世加长版 64.98 万元起，提供增程（EREV）与纯电两种动力。[s16] 旗舰 M9 的 CLTC 综合续航达 1,405 公里。[s16] 定位介于 M5 与 M7 之间的 M6 于 2026 年 3 月 23 日开启小订，订单很快突破 6 万。[s5] 赛力斯自研技术集中在魔方平台、超级增程与超级工厂智能制造体系，公司称 2025 年增程器业务市占率超 37.5%。[s15]

智能化与研发

2025 年研发投入 125.12 亿元（同比增长 77.4%），研发人员 9,019 人、占员工总数 41.1%。[s1] 问界用户 2025 年新增智能辅助驾驶里程 38 亿公里。[s5] 截至 2026 年 9 月，问界辅助驾驶活跃用户突破 100 万、累计辅助驾驶里程超 100 亿公里。[s15] 公司披露超级增程系统最高热效率为 44.8%、1 升油发电超 3.65 度。[s15] 公司于 2025 年 10 月获得 MSCI ESG 最高等级 AAA。[s5]

制造

公司问询回复披露，截至 2024 年 9 月末，两江工厂生产 M5 系列（设计产能 5 万辆/年）、凤凰工厂生产 M7 系列（10 万辆/年）、超级工厂生产 M9 系列（15 万辆/年）；其他整车工厂生产风光、蓝电、东风小康等系列（30 万辆/年）。该表为历史分布，不能代表研究截止日的车型分工或产能。[s10] 后续公司投资者关系活动记录披露，2025 年上半年超级工厂已实现问界 M8 与 M9 共线生产。[s27] 超级工厂此前为租赁使用，2025 年集团以发行股份方式完成对业主龙盛新能源 100% 股权的收购（作价 81.64 亿元），将工厂纳入自有资产体系。[s1]

国内市场地位

问界是集团的主力品牌。2025 年问界交付超 42 万辆，其中 M9 超 11 万辆（蝉联 50 万元级销量冠军）、M8 超 15 万辆（位居 40 万元级细分市场第一）、全新 M7 超 11 万辆。[s23] 集团口径下，2025 年汽车总销量 516,860 辆（新能源汽车 472,269 辆），高于 2024 年的 497,008 辆（新能源汽车 426,885 辆）。[s1][s3] 2026 年上半年集团毛利率为 23.30%；第二季度存货周转天数为 7.5 天；截至 6 月末，现金储备超 731.5 亿元（占总资产 57.0%，该指标包含货币资金、交易性金融资产等）。[s4]

海外业务

集团海外业务以东风小康/风光传统出口与 SERES 自有新能源品牌为主。2025 年境外销量 28,641 辆（其中新能源汽车 7,778 辆、其他车型 20,863 辆），国外营业收入 23.79 亿元。[s1] SERES 5 已在欧洲、中东及拉美等市场销售。[s6] 2026 年 2 月 6 日，问界品牌新闻稿披露与 ADM 旗下 Performance Plus Motors 签署阿联酋渠道合作协议，由后者负责当地销售、交付及售后；协议披露本身不代表正式上市或已完成客户交付。[s26] 2026 年 10 月问界亮相巴黎车展，赛力斯官宣计划 2027 年秋季进入欧洲市场。[s14]

leadership.en:
Founder and actual controller

Zhang Xinghai (张兴海), born 1963 with a postgraduate degree and the title of senior economist, is the founder, actual controller and chairman of Seres Group. He started the Fenghuang Electric Spring Factory in 1986 and later founded the Yu'an Group.[s17] He holds 50% of Chongqing Sokon Holdings; the 2025 annual report identifies him as the actual controller.[s1] His current public roles include membership of the 14th CPPCC Standing Committee, vice chairmanship of the All-China Federation of Industry and Commerce, and chairmanship of the Chongqing Federation of Industry and Commerce. He previously served as a delegate to the 13th National People's Congress.[s7] He was elected chairman of the sixth board on 22 April 2026.[s18]

Key management

  • Yin Xianzhi (尹先知) — director and president of the company, appointed 22 April 2026. Born January 1968, a CCP member with a party-school postgraduate degree; previously held positions in Chongqing Shapingba District government (including township head and district finance director) and state-linked urban-investment firms, and was previously a director and vice president of Seres.[s18]
  • Kang Bo (康波) — director and vice president. Born December 1975 with a doctorate in business administration; nearly 30 years in China's auto and parts industry, including 12 years at BMW China and BMW's Germany headquarters at China and group vice-president level, and roles at Delphi as China managing director of a business division and head of the independent aftermarket for Asia-Pacific.[s7]
  • Zhou Lin (周林) — vice president. Born September 1980 with an executive MBA; previously assistant general manager and CTO of Dongfeng Sokon, executive deputy general manager of the Seres Auto technology centre and deputy general manager of Seres Auto, and the company's chief technology officer (CTO); now vice president.[s7]
  • Shen Wei (申薇) — vice president and board secretary. Born May 1982 with an LL.M.; previously at Beijing King & Wood Mallesons, Yushang Investment Group and Chongqing Xizheng Yufu Equity Investment Fund Management, and a former supervisor and director of the company; now vice president and board secretary.[s7]
  • Wang Ping (王平) — vice president. Born October 1973 with a bachelor's degree; previously at Qingling Motors, Zongshen Technology Development and Changan Ford; now vice president.[s7]
  • Liu Lian (刘联) — chief financial officer. Born November 1967 with an executive MBA and the title of accountant; previously at Chongqing Hongyan Internal Combustion Engine, then deputy general manager of the shock-absorber division and assistant to the president of Chongqing Sokon Auto Group, and a director and vice president of the company; now chief financial officer.[s7]

Shareholding and governance

As of 31 December 2025 the largest shareholder was Chongqing Sokon Holdings (22.99%), followed by Dongfeng Motor Group (18.79%), HKSCC Nominees (6.23%), Chongqing Yu'an Auto Industry (3.79%) and Chongqing Industrial Investment Mother Fund (3.05%).[s1] By 24 September 2026 Chongqing Sokon Holdings had raised its holding to 23.23%, with persons acting in concert (Zhang Zhengping and Chongqing Yu'an Auto Industry) holding 27.03% in total.[s13] The sixth board elected on 22 April 2026 has Zhang Xinghai as chairman and Yin Xianzhi as president.[s18]
leadership.zh:
创始人与实际控制人

张兴海，1963 年出生，研究生学历，高级经济师，赛力斯集团创始人、实际控制人、董事长。1986 年创办凤凰电器弹簧厂，后创立渝安集团。[s17] 其持有重庆小康控股 50% 股权；2025 年年报认定张兴海为公司实际控制人。[s1] 他现任第十四届全国政协常务委员、全国工商联副主席、重庆市工商联主席（总商会会长）；曾任第十三届全国人大代表。[s7] 2026 年 4 月 22 日当选第六届董事会董事长。[s18]

核心管理层

  • 尹先知 — 董事、公司总裁，2026 年 4 月 22 日获聘任。1968 年 1 月生，中共党员，市委党校研究生学历；曾任重庆市沙坪坝区曾家镇镇长、区财政局局长等政府职务及多家国资平台职务，此前任赛力斯董事、副总裁。[s18]
  • 康波 — 董事、副总裁。1975 年 12 月生，工商管理博士，在中国汽车及零部件行业工作近 30 年，其中在宝马中国及德国全球总部工作 12 年，担任中国及集团副总裁级别工作，还曾在德尔福担任事业部中国区董事总经理、独立售后市场亚太区负责人。[s7]
  • 周林 — 副总裁。1980 年 9 月生，高级工商管理硕士；曾任东风小康汽车有限公司总经理助理、CTO，赛力斯汽车有限公司科技中心常务副总经理、副总经理，公司首席技术官（CTO），现任公司副总裁。[s7]
  • 申薇 — 副总裁、董事会秘书。1982 年 5 月生，法学硕士；曾任职于北京市金杜律师事务所、渝商投资集团股份有限公司、重庆西证渝富股权投资基金管理有限公司，曾任公司监事、董事，现任公司副总裁、董事会秘书。[s7]
  • 王平 — 副总裁。1973 年 10 月生，学士学位；曾就职于庆铃汽车股份有限公司、宗申技术开发研究有限公司、长安福特汽车有限公司，现任公司副总裁。[s7]
  • 刘联 — 财务总监。1967 年 11 月生，高级工商管理硕士，会计师；曾就职于重庆红岩内燃机有限责任公司，曾任重庆小康汽车集团有限公司减震器事业部副总经理、总裁助理，公司董事、副总裁，现任公司财务总监。[s7]

股权与治理

截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，第一大股东为重庆小康控股（22.99%），其后依次为东风汽车集团（18.79%）、HKSCC Nominees（6.23%）、重庆渝安汽车工业（3.79%）、重庆产业投资母基金（3.05%）。[s1] 截至 2026 年 9 月 24 日，重庆小康控股持股已升至 23.23%，与一致行动人（张正萍、重庆渝安汽车工业）合计持股 27.03%。[s13] 2026 年 4 月 22 日选举产生的第六届董事会由张兴海任董事长，尹先知任总裁。[s18]

competition.en:
Main competitors

Our judgment: given AITO's SUV line-up and official starting prices, a useful comparison set includes Tesla, Li Auto, XPeng, Zeekr, Avatr, other HIMA brands and electric offerings from premium German brands. This is our analytical peer selection.[s16]

Strengths

  • Our judgment: Deep Huawei integration: the HarmonySpace cockpit and Qiankun ADS give AITO a strong intelligent-driving and brand story, and Huawei's retail reach supported its rise.[s21]
  • A premium scale position: AITO delivered over 420,000 vehicles in 2025. Our judgment: this provides a customer base for its sales and service operations.[s5]
  • Our judgment: Vertical manufacturing and in-house EREV technology, including the Super Factory and a leading range-extender position (over 37.5% segment share in 2025).[s15]
  • Our judgment: Scale in intelligent driving: by September 2026 AITO had passed one million assisted-driving active users and 10 billion km of cumulative assisted-driving mileage, a large real-world data base.[s15]

Weaknesses

  • NEV business concentration: this business represented about 94.3% of group revenue in 2025. The annual report does not separately disclose AITO revenue, so this cannot establish that AITO or five SUVs generated nearly all revenue.[s1]
  • Our judgment: a sales recovery remains challenging. January–September 2026 NEV sales fell 15.8% year on year; a sustained recovery from new models remains to be demonstrated.[s11]
  • Our judgment: A thin net margin: attributable net profit of RMB5,957 million on revenue of RMB165,054 million (about 3.6%) is far below the 29.1% gross margin, reflecting heavy R&D, selling and channel spend.[s1]
  • Our judgment: Non-AITO diversification remains limited: overseas NEV sales were 7,778 in 2025, and Saidou Technology was deconsolidated in July 2026.[s1][s4]

Our judgment

Our judgment: AITO's premium volume shows the Huawei partnership works commercially, but the 2026 revenue decline, the first-half loss and the shift of operations to Seres's leadership indicate that profitability is not yet independent of Huawei's product momentum and the five-SUV model cycle. The gross margin cited here is the group's consolidated 29.14%; the company does not disclose an AITO-brand gross margin, so it cannot be used directly to argue for AITO's pricing power.[s1][s4]

Our judgment: following the partnership changes, Seres needs to demonstrate its ability to organise product development, marketing and retail. An uneven handover or product updates that fail to revive sales could delay earnings recovery. This assessment does not substitute for undisclosed AITO revenue or profit data.[s4][s15][s21]
competition.zh:
主要对手

我们的判断：结合问界的 SUV 产品与官方起售价，竞品对比可重点考察特斯拉、理想、小鹏、极氪、阿维塔及鸿蒙智行其他品牌，并关注德系豪华品牌的电动车产品。该名单是研究比较范围。[s16]

优势

  • 我们的判断：深度绑定华为：鸿蒙座舱与乾崑智驾 ADS 赋予问界较强的智能化与品牌势能，华为的零售渠道亦助推其崛起。[s21]
  • 高端规模地位：2025 年问界交付超 42 万辆；我们的判断是，这为其销售与服务体系提供了用户基础。[s5]
  • 我们的判断：垂直制造与自研增程技术，包括超级工厂与领先的增程器地位（2025 年市占率超 37.5%）。[s15]
  • 我们的判断：智能驾驶规模：截至 2026 年 9 月，问界辅助驾驶活跃用户突破 100 万、累计辅助驾驶里程超 100 亿公里，积累了大规模真实路况数据。[s15]

短板

  • 新能源汽车业务集中度：2025 年该业务收入约占集团营收 94.3%；年报未单独披露问界品牌收入，不能据此断言问界或五款 SUV 贡献几乎全部收入。[s1]
  • 我们的判断：销量修复仍有压力；2026 年 1–9 月新能源汽车销量同比下滑 15.8%，新车型能否带动持续恢复仍待观察。[s11]
  • 我们的判断：净利率偏低：归母净利润 59.57 亿元÷营收 1,650.54 亿元（约 3.6%）远低于 29.1% 的毛利率，反映研发、销售与渠道投入较重。[s1]
  • 我们的判断：非问界业务的分散作用尚有限：2025 年境外新能源汽车销量为 7,778 辆；2026 年 7 月赛豆科技不再并表。[s1][s4]

我们的判断

我们的判断：问界的高端销量说明华为合作模式在商业上成立，但 2026 年营收下滑、上半年亏损以及运营转向赛力斯主导，表明公司盈利尚未独立于华为的产品势能与五款 SUV 的车型周期。此处引用的毛利率为集团综合口径 29.14%，公司未单独披露问界品牌毛利率，故不能据此直接论证问界的定价能力。[s1][s4]

我们的判断：合作模式调整后，赛力斯需要验证自主组织产品、营销与零售的执行能力；若交接不顺或产品迭代未能带动销量恢复，盈利修复可能承压。这一判断不能替代尚未披露的问界品牌收入或利润数据。[s4][s15][s21]

outlook.en:
Company targets and latest disclosures

In its 2025 annual report the company said it would focus on the premium intelligent EV business, accelerate overseas model development and operations, and push into robotics and other new businesses, targeting a second million AITO vehicles within two years.[s5] In early 2026 it refreshed its line-up — the M6 opened pre-orders on 23 March 2026 and the M8 and M7 received upgrades.[s5] For overseas, Seres announced at the 2026 Paris Motor Show a plan to enter the European market in autumn 2027.[s14] The latest operating figures were as follows: H1 2026 revenue was RMB57,493 million with an attributable net loss of RMB1,717 million, and January–September 2026 new energy vehicle sales fell 15.8% year on year to 256,521 units.[s4][s11] The 15 September 2026 cooperation-model adjustment transfers product definition, marketing, retail and service to Seres while Huawei continues technology empowerment.[s21]

Our analysis

Our judgment: Seres's 2024–2025 profitability was driven by AITO's product cycle and Huawei's brand pull; whether it is sustained depends on conditions that are not guaranteed — a successful handover of marketing and retail to Seres without losing Huawei's traffic, a fresh product cycle to reverse the 2026 volume decline (the company said the new-generation M9 delivered over 40,000 units in its first 16 weeks), and a path for overseas and non-AITO businesses to offset domestic concentration. If these conditions fail, the first-half loss and volume decline could extend into the second half.[s15][s4][s11]
outlook.zh:
公司目标与最新披露

赛力斯在 2025 年年报中表示，将坚定聚焦高端智能电动汽车主业，加快面向海外市场的车型研发与运营体系搭建，并推进智能机器人等新业务落地，力争两年内实现第二个百万辆目标。[s5] 2026 年初公司加快产品迭代——M6 于 3 月 23 日开启小订，M8、M7 迎来焕新升级。[s5] 海外方面，赛力斯在 2026 巴黎车展上官宣计划 2027 年秋季进入欧洲市场。[s14] 最新经营数据为：2026 年上半年营收 574.93 亿元、归母净亏损 17.17 亿元，1–9 月新能源汽车销量 25.65 万辆、同比下滑 15.8%。[s4][s11] 2026 年 9 月 15 日的合作模式调整将产品定义、营销、零售与服务转由赛力斯主导、华为继续技术赋能。[s21]

我们的分析

我们的判断：赛力斯 2024–2025 两年的盈利由问界的车型周期与华为的品牌势能驱动；能否持续，取决于若干并不必然成立的条件——在不流失华为流量前提下顺利完成营销与零售交接、以新一轮产品周期扭转 2026 年销量下滑（公司称全新一代 M9 上市 16 周交付超 4 万辆），以及海外与非问界业务能否对冲国内集中度。若这些条件不成立，上半年亏损与销量收缩可能延续至下半年。[s15][s4][s11]

risks.en:
Disclosed operating and financial conditions

  • Operations: H1 2026 attributable net loss was RMB1,717 million; January–September NEV sales fell 15.8% year on year.[s4][s11]
  • Concentration: NEVs generated about 94.3% of FY2025 revenue; AITO revenue and profit were not separately disclosed.[s1]
  • Cash flow: FY2025 financing cash flow increased mainly through H-share proceeds.[s1] H1 2026 investing net outflow was RMB21,544 million (prior-year period: RMB6,966 million). The interim report attributes the change mainly to cash management using idle funds to optimise allocation.[s4]

Company-disclosed risks

The H1 2026 report lists policy, demand, competition, supply-chain and international risks, including materials and component supply, trade barriers, exchange rates and market access.[s4]
risks.zh:
已披露的经营与财务情况

  • 经营表现：2026 年上半年归母净亏损 17.17 亿元；1–9 月新能源汽车销量同比下滑 15.8%。[s4][s11]
  • 业务集中度：2025 年新能源汽车业务收入约占集团营收 94.3%，年报未单独披露问界品牌收入或利润。[s1]
  • 现金流：2025 年筹资现金流增加主要来自 H 股募集资金。[s1] 2026 年上半年投资活动现金净流出 215.44 亿元（上年同期 69.66 亿元）；半年报将其变动主要归因为优化资金配置、利用闲置资金开展现金管理。[s4]

公司披露的风险

2026 年半年报列示政策支持变动、市场需求波动、行业竞争加剧、供应链以及国际经济政治形势变化等风险；其中供应链风险涉及原材料价格、芯片与电池等关键零部件供给，海外风险涉及贸易壁垒、汇率与准入规则。[s4]
